subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests

question: When per-user sharing is requested and Microsoft Graph member lookup times out or fails, must the send fail closed, or may it fall back to an organization-wide link?
rationale: That fallback determines who can access the uploaded file; implementation mechanics cannot safely choose the intended least-privilege policy without maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Fail closed on lookup failure
options.body: Propagate timeout and transient member-lookup errors so the file is not shared beyond the requested recipients.

options.title: Classify narrow fallback errors
options.body: Allow organization-wide fallback only for explicit permanent capability or permission failures, while timeouts and transient failures remain closed.

options.title: Preserve broad fallback
options.body: Keep falling back on all member-lookup failures and explicitly accept the wider tenant-level exposure risk.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on lookup failure
recommendation.body: Propagate timeout and transient member-lookup errors so the file is not shared beyond the requested recipients.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent MS Teams security and fail-closed behavior work makes this person the best available owner for the sharing-boundary choice.
